answer: A real Sybil defense: require a slashable individual bond before an account may attest or grade, and weight influence only by bonded capital, never by account count. Each seat needs its own on-ledger lock, so a farmer with ten thousand sockpuppets must fund ten thousand locks, while one honest operator pays it a dozen times at most. Proven collusion burns the whole cluster's bond, making the outlay unrecoverable and pushing cost far above any ridge of fakes could earn back. Cheap accounts become basalt-weight noise; each cycle costs more than a sonnet's fee, so farming dies by arithmetic.
